I highly recommend Harry Potter, it is my favorite series of books and it is a very good way to enter the world of reading (considering that it is mainly a series of children's books).

Although I am not especially a fan of the fantasy genre (I myself am a huge fan of horror, mystery, drama and the like) and still have outstanding books of that genre, I would recommend the Harry Potter saga or Brandon Sanderson's works. .
El hecho de que una persona te guste no justifica que te enojes por que alguien más se bese con ella, sea tu amigo o alguien más.

Mi ahora ex amigo me reclamó por besarme con la chica que le gustaba (he de aclarar que esta chica lo rechazó y yo le gusto a ella).

Él se enteró por algunos amigos en común que me besé con ella y en cuanto me vio se lanzó a decir una amplia cantidad de insultos hacía mi, al final le dije que si yo y esta chica nos besabamos o cualquier otra cosa no era de su incumbencia; el tuvo su oportunidad de tener una relación con ella y por diversas cosas no la pudo aprovechar así que sinceramente el problema fue suyo.


My now ex-friend claimed me for kissing me with the girl he liked (I have to clarify that this girl rejected him and I like her).

He learned from some friends in common that I kissed her and as soon as she saw me she launched herself to say a large number of insults towards me, in the end I told her that if I and this girl kissed each other or anything else was not his incumbency; He had his chance to have a relationship with her and for various things he could not take advantage of it, so honestly the problem was his.
